messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the person's identity to match the person in the reference photo. Use the reference photo only to determine the target person's facial identity and skin tone. Apply that skin tone consistently to the face and body. Retain the current hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, scene, and camera.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the person's identity to match the person in the reference photo. Only use the reference photo to determine the target person's facial identity and skin tone. Apply that skin tone consistently to the face and body, while retaining the current hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, scene, and camera.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character walks forward toward the camera, then bends down to adjust her right sandal, and finally stands upright and turns her head to look over her shoulder.","camera":"A static, low-angle full-body shot that captures the character from head to toe against the background.","clothing":"A long, sleeveless red satin dress with gold and green floral embroidery on the bodice and waist, paired with a light gray knitted shawl draped over the shoulders and black strappy sandals.","hair_color":"Reddish-brown.","hairstyle":"Reddish-brown hair styled in two high buns on top of the head, with a center part and bangs.","identity":"A 3D-rendered female character with a slender build, pale skin, and a stylized anime-like face.","scene":"An outdoor rural setting with a dirt path, tall green grass, and a traditional thatched-roof building in the background under a clear blue sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output remains visually identical to the source: the character keeps the same stylized anime-like face, pale skin, reddish-brown buns, red dress, gray shawl, sandals, walking/bending action, rural scene, and static low-angle camera. No visible facial identity or skin-tone change toward the reference was made.
arguments.requested_change: Change the character's facial identity and skin tone to match the reference person, while retaining hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, action, scene, and camera.
uncertain: Whether any extremely subtle facial or skin-tone change exists is not visible in the provided frames.
